headline: Tk 16.25 crore gold seized: 80 gold bars found in Biman workers' shoes at Dhaka airport
summary: Customs officials recovered over 9kg of gold hidden in the footwear of two airline staff members arriving from Dubai.
details: Customs intelligence officials recovered 80 gold bars weighing approximately 9.34kg from the shoes of two airline staff members at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka.
Acting on a tip-off, the Customs Intelligence and Investigation Directorate (CIID) intercepted the two staff members as they arrived on an Emirates Airlines flight from Dubai.
The gold bars, each weighing around 117 grammes, were allegedly concealed inside the shoes using a special method to evade customs checks.
The total estimated market value of the seized gold is approximately Tk 16.25 crore, according to customs officials.
The CIID is currently investigating the origin of the gold, the intended recipient, and other individuals involved in the smuggling attempt.

The total estimated market value of the seized gold is approximately Tk 16.25 crore, according to customs officials.

The CIID is currently investigating the origin of the gold, the intended recipient, and other individuals involved in the smuggling attempt.

headline: PM directs faster construction of Dhaka ring road to ease traffic
summary: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has ordered officials to accelerate the Inner Circular Ring Road project to reduce congestion in the capital.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has instructed officials to accelerate the construction of the Inner Circular Ring Road, a project designed to significantly reduce traffic congestion in Dhaka.

At a review meeting held at the Cabinet Division in the Prime Minister’s Office on Sunday, the PM emphasized the need for "visible progress" and directed officials to remove existing obstacles quickly.
The PM has asked the Ministry of Road Transport and Bridges and the Local Government Division to jointly review the project plan and set a realistic deadline for completion.

One section of the ring road will extend from Abdullahpur Railgate through Dhour, Birulia, Gabtoli, Bosila, Hazaribagh, Sadarghat, Kadamtali, Tegharia, Posta, Fatullah, Chashara, and Shimrail to Demra.
Another section will run from the railgate through Teramukh, Purbachal, and Beraid to Demra, allowing travelers to bypass the city center entirely.

Construction is currently underway in the Rayerbazar, Hazaribagh, and Kamrangirchar sections. Once complete, it will allow people to travel from one end of the capital to the other without using internal city roads.
